services.desc: "Two Sonny" is a 32 ft Everglades center console with twin Yamaha 350 HP engines. It is fully equipped with radar, sonar, radio, gps, private bathroom, music radio, and more. This boat was specifically made to go offshore to target big fish and be able to handle the weather. There are plenty of comfortable seats for your entire party and even a built-in retractable table that can fit 5 people to have lunch or a drink. Everglades are known for being built with the best material and having a patent for how they build it which makes the boat unsinkable.
